operation.description:
Get a ruleset for a repository.

**Note:** To prevent leaking sensitive information, the `bypass_actors` property is only returned if the user
making the API request has write access to the ruleset.

parameters.description: Include rulesets configured at higher levels that apply to this repository
parameters.name: includes_parents

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/org-ruleset-conditi.description:
Conditions for an organization ruleset.
The branch and tag rulesets conditions object should contain both `repository_name` and `ref_name` properties, or both `repository_id` and `ref_name` properties, or both `repository_property` and `ref_name` properties.
The push rulesets conditions object does not require the `ref_name` property.
For repository policy rulesets, the conditions object should only contain the `repository_name`, the `repository_id`, or the `repository_property`.

oneOf.description: Conditions to target repositories by name and refs by name
oneOf.title: repository_name_and_ref_name

oneOf.description: Conditions to target repositories by id and refs by name
oneOf.title: repository_id_and_ref_name

oneOf.description: Conditions to target repositories by property and refs by name
oneOf.title: repository_property_and_ref_name

#/components/schemas/org-ruleset-conditi.title: Organization ruleset conditions

#/components/schemas/repository-rule-mer.description: Merges must be performed via a merge queue.

check_response_timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time for a required status check to report a conclusion. After this much time has elapsed, checks that have not reported a conclusion will be assumed to have failed

grouping_strategy.description: When set to ALLGREEN, the merge commit created by merge queue for each PR in the group must pass all required checks to merge. When set to HEADGREEN, only the commit at the head of the merge group, i.e. the commit containing changes from all of the PRs in the group, must pass its required checks to merge.

max_entries_to_build.description: Limit the number of queued pull requests requesting checks and workflow runs at the same time.

max_entries_to_merge.description: The maximum number of PRs that will be merged together in a group.

merge_method.description: Method to use when merging changes from queued pull requests.

min_entries_to_merge.description: The minimum number of PRs that will be merged together in a group.

min_entries_to_merge_wait_minutes.description: The time merge queue should wait after the first PR is added to the queue for the minimum group size to be met. After this time has elapsed, the minimum group size will be ignored and a smaller group will be merged.

#/components/schemas/repository-rule-mer.title: merge_queue

#/components/schemas/repository-rule-pul.description: Require all commits be made to a non-target branch and submitted via a pull request before they can be merged.

require_code_owner_review.description: Require an approving review in pull requests that modify files that have a designated code owner.

require_last_push_approval.description: Whether the most recent reviewable push must be approved by someone other than the person who pushed it.

required_approving_review_count.description: The number of approving reviews that are required before a pull request can be merged.

required_review_thread_resolution.description: All conversations on code must be resolved before a pull request can be merged.

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset.description: A set of rules to apply when specified conditions are met.

href.description: The html URL of the ruleset

bypass_actors.description: The actors that can bypass the rules in this ruleset

current_user_can_bypass.description:
The bypass type of the user making the API request for this ruleset. This field is only returned when

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset.title: Repository ruleset

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.description: An actor that can bypass rules in a ruleset

actor_id.description: The ID of the actor that can bypass a ruleset. Required for `Integration`, `RepositoryRole`, `Team`, and `User` actor types. If `actor_type` is `OrganizationAdmin`, `actor_id` is ignored. If `actor_type` is `DeployKey`, this should be null. `OrganizationAdmin` is not applicable for personal repositories.

actor_type.description: The type of actor that can bypass a ruleset.

bypass_mode.description: When the specified actor can bypass the ruleset. `pull_request` means that an actor can only bypass rules on pull requests. `pull_request` is not applicable for the `DeployKey` actor type. Also, `pull_request` is only applicable to branch rulesets. When `bypass_mode` is `exempt`, rules will not be run for that actor and a bypass audit entry will not be created.

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.title: Repository Ruleset Bypass Actor

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.description: Parameters for a repository ruleset ref name condition

exclude.description: Array of ref names or patterns to exclude. The condition will not pass if any of these patterns match.

include.description: Array of ref names or patterns to include. One of these patterns must match for the condition to pass. Also accepts `~DEFAULT_BRANCH` to include the default branch or `~ALL` to include all branches.

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.title: Repository ruleset conditions for ref names

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.description: Parameters for a repository ID condition

repository_ids.description: The repository IDs that the ruleset applies to. One of these IDs must match for the condition to pass.

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.title: Repository ruleset conditions for repository IDs

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.description: Parameters for a repository name condition

exclude.description: Array of repository names or patterns to exclude. The condition will not pass if any of these patterns match.

include.description: Array of repository names or patterns to include. One of these patterns must match for the condition to pass. Also accepts `~ALL` to include all repositories.

protected.description: Whether renaming of target repositories is prevented.

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.title: Repository ruleset conditions for repository names

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.description: Parameters for a targeting a repository property

name.description: The name of the repository property to target

property_values.description: The values to match for the repository property

source.description: The source of the repository property. Defaults to 'custom' if not specified.

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.title: Repository ruleset property targeting definition

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.description: Parameters for a repository property condition

exclude.description: The repository properties and values to exclude. The condition will not pass if any of these properties match.

include.description: The repository properties and values to include. All of these properties must match for the condition to pass.

#/components/schemas/repository-ruleset-.title: Repository ruleset conditions for repository properties
